crossRefs.note: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against Yahweh and against you. Pray to…
He removed the high places, and broke the pillars, and cut down the Asherah. He also broke in pieces the bronze serpent…
Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do…
And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.
How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”
He took the twelve aside, and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written…
and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.
Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”
Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning…
He said to them, “This is what I told you, while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of…
him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men…
“For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against…
to do whatever your hand and your council foreordained to happen.
